title: UAE Annual Precipitation and Flood Event Frequency (2015-2025)
executive_question: How has the frequency and intensity of flood events in the UAE evolved over the past decade?
required_metrics: Annual total precipitation (mm) for UAE (2015-2025)
Annual number of flood events in UAE (2015-2025)
Annual economic losses due to floods (USD) (2015-2025)
preferred_sources: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal
data_quality_rule: Use official meteorological and disaster databases. If annual data is incomplete, use at least 4 data points and clearly mark interpolated values as estimates.
narrative_role: Establishes the escalating flood risk in the UAE, justifying the market opportunity.
pre_exhibit_context: The report argues that UAE cities face escalating flood risks due to climate change and urbanization.
post_exhibit_takeaway: The data shows a clear upward trend in flood events and precipitation, supporting the need for advanced flood resilience solutions.

title: UAE Government Climate Resilience Infrastructure Investment (2020-2030)
executive_question: How is UAE government investment in climate resilience infrastructure expected to grow?
required_metrics: Annual government expenditure on climate resilience infrastructure (USD) (2020-2030)
Annual budget allocation for flood management (USD) (2020-2030)
Number of climate resilience projects initiated (2020-2030)
comparison_set: UAE federal and emirate-level budgets over time
preferred_sources: UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment
data_quality_rule: Use official budget documents and project announcements. If future years are projections, clearly label as estimates and cite the source of the forecast.
narrative_role: Demonstrates a favorable policy and funding environment for flood resilience solutions.
pre_exhibit_context: The report claims that UAE government initiatives and budgets support climate adaptation.
post_exhibit_takeaway: The upward trend in government investment signals a growing market and willingness to fund resilience projects.

title: Competitive Landscape: Flood Resilience Solution Providers in the UAE

required_metrics: Company name
Market share (%) in UAE flood resilience
Number of projects completed in UAE
Revenue from flood resilience solutions (USD) (latest year)
Technology focus (e.g., drainage, monitoring, pumping)
